findings.description: Plan path override regex could be more restrictive
findings.suggestion: The regex for extracting Plan: override only checks for traversal segments (`*..*`). Consider also rejecting paths with control characters, Unicode control chars, or absolute paths to make the override more robust against injection attempts.

findings.description: planMetadata function insufficiently escapes control characters
findings.suggestion: The planMetadata function only escapes newlines and angle brackets. Consider using a more comprehensive sanitization function that also handles backspace, vertical tab, form feed, and Unicode control characters (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F) to prevent log forging attacks.

findings.description: Timeout increase lacks justification comment
findings.suggestion: The DEFAULT_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS was increased from 120s to 300s with a detailed comment, but DEFAULT_IMPL_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS is set to 300s without similar justification. Add a comment explaining why this timeout is needed for the implementation review pass.

findings.description: Inconsistent escaping of untrusted plan path
findings.suggestion: The plan path is escaped using codeSpan() in renderImplReviewSection, but planMetadata() uses a different escaping approach. Consider using the same escaping function consistently for plan paths throughout the codebase.

findings.description: Plan length logging could reveal sensitive information
findings.suggestion: Logging the exact character count of the plan file could potentially leak information about plan contents in a side-channel attack. Consider rounding or bucketing the length value (e.g., '<1KB', '1-10KB', '10-100KB', '>100KB') to reduce information leakage.

findings.description: Schema validation allows potentially inconsistent grades
findings.suggestion: The consistency check only validates that CRITICAL findings have FAIL grades and WARNING findings don't have PASS grades. Consider adding a check that REJECTED verdicts must have at least one FAIL grade to prevent contradictory verdicts.

findings.description: Plan resolution logic has complex regex for PR body override
findings.suggestion: The regex for parsing `Plan:` lines from PR body is complex and could be vulnerable to edge cases. Consider using a more robust parser or adding more test cases for edge cases like multiple Plan: lines, malformed paths, etc.

findings.description: Tool-less agent may have limited context awareness
findings.suggestion: The implementation reviewer is tool-less by design. While this provides cost predictability, it may limit the model's ability to understand file context. Consider documenting this trade-off clearly and monitoring for cases where additional context would be valuable.

findings.description: Plan path logging uses simple character replacement
findings.suggestion: The `logSafePath` function only replaces newlines and `<` characters. Consider using a more comprehensive sanitization function for untrusted paths to prevent other potential log injection vectors.

findings.description: Vendored criteria may drift from source
findings.suggestion: The implementation review criteria are vendored from the skill but with deliberate changes. Add a comment documenting the specific divergences and a periodic review process to sync changes back to the source skill when appropriate.

findings.description: Timeout constant increased without detailed justification
findings.suggestion: The DEFAULT_IMPL_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS was increased from 120s to 300s. While the comment explains the reasoning, consider adding metrics or references to actual run times to justify this increase.

findings.description: Implementation review uses different emoji vocabulary
findings.suggestion: The implementation review uses different emojis (🟢🟡🔴) than the code review (✅❌). While this is intentional to prevent confusion, consider adding a comment explaining this design choice for future maintainers.

findings.description: Plan resolution and staging logic is complex and error-prone
findings.suggestion: Consider extracting the plan resolution logic into a separate, reusable script or composite action for better maintainability and testing.

findings.description: The sed regex for extracting Plan: override uses POSIX ERE but runs with default GNU sed behavior
findings.suggestion: Explicitly add '-E' flag to sed command to ensure ERE behavior across platforms, or consider using grep -P for PCRE if available.

findings.description: Array expansion for EXCLUDES may fail with paths containing spaces
findings.suggestion: Add quotes around array expansion: git diff ... -- . "${EXCLUDES[@]}" to handle paths with spaces safely.

findings.description: Plan truncation at 80,000 chars may still be too large for some models
findings.suggestion: Consider adding a configurable plan cap via environment variable, similar to how timeouts are configurable.

findings.description: Instruction strings could be extracted to constants for better readability
findings.suggestion: Extract the large instruction strings (IMPL_REVIEW_COMPARISON_RULE, etc.) to named constants at the top of the file.

findings.description: CodeSpan function is not defined in the provided diff
findings.suggestion: Ensure codeSpan is properly imported or defined, as it's used in renderImplReviewSection but not visible in this diff.

findings.description: lineNumber helper function is used but not defined in the visible code
findings.suggestion: Ensure lineNumber function is properly exported/imported as it's used in implFindingSchema but not visible in this diff.

findings.description: logSafePath function is used but not defined in the visible code
findings.suggestion: Ensure logSafePath is properly defined to sanitize control characters in PLAN_PATH.

findings.description: Plan staging logic has good security controls but the error handling could be clearer
findings.suggestion: Add more explicit error messages for different failure modes (symlink, missing file, etc.)

findings.description: Informational message logged to stderr might confuse users
findings.suggestion: Use stdout for informational messages or prefix with 'info:' to distinguish from errors

findings.description: Plan cap of 80,000 characters might be too generous for some repos
findings.suggestion: Consider making the plan cap configurable via environment variable

findings.description: Instruction mentions grading dimensions but could be clearer about the grading criteria
findings.suggestion: Add more specific guidance on what constitutes each grade level

findings.description: Variable name 'implReview' is abbreviated
findings.suggestion: Consider using 'implementationReview' for clarity, though this is consistent with the codebase style

findings.description: Plan resolution regex is complex and could miss valid paths or accept invalid ones
findings.suggestion: Simplify the regex to `^Plan: context/(changes|archive)/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+/plan\.md$` and add a comment explaining the anchoring requirements

findings.description: DEFAULT_IMPL_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS is set to 5 minutes (300,000ms) which is excessive for a single LLM call
findings.suggestion: Reduce to 120,000ms (2 minutes) to match the original judge timeout, or add a comment justifying why this pass needs more time

findings.description: HTML escaping in planMetadata is incorrect - `<\` is not a valid escape sequence
findings.suggestion: Replace `replace(/</g, "<\\")` with `replace(/</g, "<")` to properly escape angle brackets

findings.description: Plan path escaping could be more robust
findings.suggestion: Consider using a dedicated sanitize function for plan paths that also escapes backticks and other markdown metacharacters

findings.description: logSafePath is used but not defined in this file
findings.suggestion: Add a comment noting that logSafePath is imported from elsewhere, or define it inline if it's simple

findings.description: plan-path input lacks validation
findings.suggestion: Add validation to ensure plan-path is a relative path without dangerous characters

findings.description: Good security practices for plan resolution
findings.suggestion: None - this is well implemented

findings.description: PLAN_CAP_CHARS is set to 80,000 which may consume significant context
findings.suggestion: Consider making this configurable or reducing based on observed plan sizes

findings.description: Plan file is read even when it might be empty
findings.suggestion: Check file size before reading to avoid unnecessary I/O

findings.description: Empty plan handling could be clearer
findings.suggestion: Add clearer logging to distinguish between empty file and no plan scenarios

findings.description: runReviewPipeline function is getting long
findings.suggestion: Extract the impl review pass logic into a separate function

findings.description: MAX_RENDERED_FINDINGS is used but not defined locally
findings.suggestion: Import the constant or define it locally for clarity

findings.description: Good unit test coverage but missing integration tests
findings.suggestion: Add end-to-end tests that verify the complete workflow with a plan

findings.description: Git diff command uses single quotes for excludes array which may break with spaces in paths
findings.suggestion: Use bash array for EXCLUDES as done elsewhere in the file

findings.description: The comment references `finder-file-context` but the actual change is `impl-review-ci-agent`
findings.suggestion: Update comment to reference the correct change

findings.description: The error message for empty plan file uses 'plan file is empty' but other messages use 'plan supplied'
findings.suggestion: Consistently use 'plan' terminology in error messages

findings.description: The comment about glm-4.6 tool calls references '0/6 fixtures and 0/4 live' but this evidence is from a different change
findings.suggestion: Update or remove the specific reference to avoid confusion

findings.description: The comment about DEFAULT_JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS update mentions PR #127 but doesn't explain what happened
findings.suggestion: Add brief explanation of why the timeout was increased

findings.description: The planMetadata function escapes '<' but not other Markdown control characters like '*' or '_'
findings.suggestion: Consider escaping more Markdown control characters or use a more robust sanitization approach

findings.description: The renderImplFinding function duplicates logic from renderFinding
findings.suggestion: Extract common rendering logic to reduce duplication

findings.description: The comment about consistency rules mentions 'impl-review-phase-2 F4' which may not be meaningful to future readers
findings.suggestion: Explain the rationale rather than referencing internal tracking

findings.description: Command injection risk via unchecked PLAN_PATH
findings.suggestion: Escape PLAN_PATH when echoing to log or pass through env with proper sanitization

findings.description: Git symlink traversal could expose sensitive data
findings.suggestion: Add explicit check for symlink (mode 120000) before git show

findings.description: logSafePath undefined reference
findings.suggestion: Define logSafePath function or replace with proper escaping

findings.description: Undefined fence function
findings.suggestion: Import or define fence function used in buildImplReviewPrompt

findings.description: Undefined sanitizeInline function
findings.suggestion: Import or define sanitizeInline function used in renderImplFinding

findings.description: Potential race condition in plan staging
findings.suggestion: Add error handling around git show to prevent partial file writes on interruption

findings.description: Array expansion could fail with spaces in paths
findings.suggestion: Use array for EXCLUDES to handle paths with spaces safely

findings.description: Missing cross-reference in prompts
findings.suggestion: Add reference to plan-review F2 for exclusion rule clarification

findings.description: Inconsistent newline in error message
findings.suggestion: Remove leading newline for consistency with other error messages

findings.description: Trailing whitespace in comment
findings.suggestion: Remove trailing space after 'planTruncated: true'

findings.description: Plan staging from Git object with blob-mode check
findings.suggestion: Good security practice - using `git ls-tree` to verify blob mode prevents symlink-based attacks. This correctly mitigates the risk of a malicious `plan.md -> /proc/self/environ` exposing secrets.

findings.description: Control character sanitization in log output
findings.suggestion: Using `logSafePath` to escape control characters in PLAN_PATH prevents log injection attacks where an attacker could forge or restyle log lines.

findings.description: Tool-less design prevents model non-determinism
findings.suggestion: The deliberate decision to make the implementation reviewer tool-less (no `readPlan` tool) is sound. Based on prior evaluation evidence that models may decline to call tools, this ensures the pass always runs when a plan is present.

findings.description: Plan cap calibrated on live evidence
findings.suggestion: PLAN_CAP_CHARS set to 80,000 based on observed in-flight plan sizes (47,217 chars) is evidence-based tuning. The initial 40k would have truncated real plans mid-section.

findings.description: Consistency validation between grades and findings
findings.suggestion: The custom refinement ensures CRITICAL findings require FAIL grades and APPROVED verdicts have no FAIL grades. This prevents publishing contradictory scorecards.

findings.description: PLAN_PATH used in git command without validation
findings.suggestion: Add validation to ensure PLAN_PATH is a valid relative path before using it in git commands to prevent potential injection issues.

findings.description: All errors in implementation review are caught and converted to 'failed' block
findings.suggestion: Distinguish between configuration errors (like missing API key) which should fail fast, and transient errors which should be handled gracefully. Consider re-throwing configuration errors.

findings.description: planMetadata function only escapes < characters
findings.suggestion: Escape additional potentially dangerous characters like > and backticks, or use a proper escaping function to prevent breaking out of code spans.

findings.description: Implementation review timeout defaults to same value as finder
findings.suggestion: Consider if the implementation review needs a different default timeout based on its typical input size and processing requirements.

findings.description: planPath field lacks validation for relative path format
findings.suggestion: Add a regex pattern to validate planPath is a valid relative path to prevent rendering issues.

findings.description: Redundant null check before nullish coalescing
findings.suggestion: Remove the explicit undefined check since the nullish coalescing operator already handles this case.

findings.description: Missing JSDoc for ImplReviewPromptInput interface
findings.suggestion: Add JSDoc documentation explaining the purpose of each field in the interface.

findings.description: Missing test for plan path with control characters
findings.suggestion: Add a test case to verify plan paths containing newlines, tabs, and other control characters are properly escaped.

findings.description: Insufficient symlink protection when staging plan file
findings.suggestion: The `git ls-tree` mode check should reject symlinks (mode 120000) even when they point to regular files. Currently it only rejects when the mode is not 100644 or 100755, allowing symlinks to be staged if they resolve to a regular file.

findings.description: Plan path regex vulnerable to path traversal
findings.suggestion: The sed regex for extracting Plan: override should reject '..' sequences explicitly. Currently it only checks after the fact, which could allow malicious paths to be processed before rejection.

findings.description: Control character sanitization incomplete
findings.suggestion: logSafePath should also sanitize other control characters like \r, \t, not just newlines. Use a whitelist of printable ASCII characters.

findings.description: Plan cap may be too high for context window
findings.suggestion: PLAN_CAP_CHARS of 80,000 may exceed model context limits when combined with diff. Consider reducing to 60,000 or making it configurable.

findings.description: Inconsistent fence escaping for plan metadata
findings.suggestion: The planMetadata function escapes '<' but not other markdown special characters. Use a more comprehensive escape function or fence the entire metadata block.
